# Al Quoz Warehouse Seven

> Warehouse No. 7 is a storage building in Al Quoz, the industrial and warehousing district that runs along Sheikh Zayed Road in central Dubai. The area is the city's main light-industrial quarter, mixing distribution stores and workshops with showrooms, galleries and staff accommodation. The unit provides covered storage with attached office accommodation, loading bays and yard space for delivery vehicles.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Al Quoz, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Warehouse No. 7 in Al Quoz was built for Seddiqi & Sons in one of Dubai's main industrial and warehousing districts. It was delivered with Dubai Contracting Company as main contractor. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the warehouse, providing the mechanical, electrical and plumbing services for the facility.
